entries.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Edit ONLY our original approved Moru seal design into a premium production pixel-animation atlas. Use the seal on the LEFT of the reference; ignore all typography and old app symbol. Exactly FOUR columns x SIX rows of equal SQUARE cells (24 frames), transparent alpha PNG, portrait1024x1536. ONE continuous action reads left to right, row1 through row6. Every cell MUST have the same camera, body scale, pixel cluster size and ground anchor. Moru centered horizontally, ground at75%cell height, generous12%clear margins on every edge. Character including tail occupies about80%cell width. Frames1 and24 identical neutral, frames2–23 are carefully authored, genuinely incremental in-between poses, with anticipation, action, follow-through and gentle settle. Keep facial details crisp and consistent in ALL24 cells: two equally dark paired navy vertical eyes; a SMALL SOLID DIAMOND nose with diagonal sloping edges, not a cross or hollow ring; two short navy whiskers PER cheek; ivory cheeks and belly; round warm stone-gray body, indigo front FLIPPERS, LEFT curled forked tail with an ivory tip notch. Nonhuman seal, no clothes or hands. Masterful cute restrained hand-crafted pixel art: deliberate stepped contours, flat clean pixel clusters, very limited navy #171923, stone #d6d3c9, ivory #fff1d7, indigo #6d73d2 and muted indigo #50569c. Both eyes must remain dark navy without blue edges. NO gradients, dithering, grain, glow, shadows, text, labels, guides or extra decorations except props explicitly named below. Props stay small in the safe cell bounds and never obscure either eye/nose. Do not progressively shrink or move the character around the grid. Mild squash/stretch ONLY for a hop, dance or breathing; maintain body volume. This is an exportable source sprite sheet, not a presentation poster. Maintain the selected Moru identity exactly. ACTION: PAIRED BLINK. Neutral; upper lids begin to lower; half-lid; three-quarter lid; fully closed; closed hold; begin opening; half-open; fully open; soft settle; neutral; neutral. Keep head/body absolutely stationary.
